recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Velocity Quill: Neon Loop Rush`, a portrait-first browser canvas runner/platformer inspired by Sonic-style speed stages. Preserve a one-button jump runner: the avatar auto-runs at fixed x, score increments during active play, tap/click jumps with gravity and ground landing, stomping enemies from above awards +100 and bounces, side contact fails, and a boss fight begins after distance 1000. The boss hovers, attacks with arcing projectiles, descends into a vulnerable window, retreats, and is defeated after three valid top hits; victory adds +1000.

The public surface should feel like a neon arcade loop-city: a rebellious blue quill speedster, gold ring score, cyan/magenta speed trails, moving loop rings, checkerboard track, red badnik carts, and an Overlord drone boss. Use mobile-readable HUD panels and clear CTAs: Start Rush, Rush Again, Restart Rush. Keep implementation browser-native and stable with vanilla canvas/DOM/CSS.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) implements a canvas endless-runner/platformer. A circular avatar runs at fixed x, jumps with one tap/click, falls under gravity, lands on a ground plane, and scrolls against enemies and a later boss. Score increments every active frame and stomp rewards add 100. At distance 1000 the boss activates; it hovers, attacks with arcing projectiles, descends, becomes vulnerable, retreats, and requires three valid top hits. Game over occurs on side enemy contact, projectile contact, or invalid boss contact. Victory adds 1000 after boss hp reaches zero.

## Protected mechanics
- One-tap/click jump input, including mobile canvas-only touch prevention.
- Gravity, jump force, ground ratio, grounded state, and bounce values.
- Enemy spawn chance, movement speed, stomp test, score increment, +100 stomp reward.
- Boss trigger distance, phases, timings, projectile velocity/gravity, hp, +1000 victory reward.
- Start, game-over, victory, and restart state semantics.

## Remix trajectory
Velocity Quill: Neon Loop Rush reframes the runner as a Sonic-inspired neon arcade speed zone. The player is a blue quill speedster collecting ring-score, stomping badnik carts, and beating an Overlord drone. Presentation is rebuilt through procedural canvas art, loop-ring skyline, speed lines, mobile HUD panels, and catalog-backed fonts/media while the gameplay contract remains unchanged.

## Safe transform surfaces
HUD language, title, panel styling, canvas drawing functions, colors, particles, background layers, entity silhouettes, feedback copy, fonts, and compact GIF/audio feedback are safe. Collision dimensions and state rules are protected.
